name: Athamuff
storyline: You suddenly appear in an area and all you know is that you need to reach your final goal by moving through different locations and performing different actions.
summary:
ATHAMUFF is a game where player moves around to see and interact with different objects in an area. With a mouse and a keyboard, the player will be able to experience an interactive journey with multiple events happen during the game. RACING through several levels, the player gradually uncovers more of a lively world with deeper meanings awaiting in the adventure ahead.

The game also features numerous fully original soundtracks from the recent hit album "Mix Isa Wip" published by the well-known artist "MinoruGLS". The album consists of many tracks with various interesting genres such as experimental, instrumental, conceptual and even minimal. These will surely provide a COLORFUL music aspect to any single gaming playthrough.
